title: Girl in Swimsuit Playing with Garden Hose in Backyard, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor black-and-white snapshot depicting a young girl kneeling on a sun-dappled lawn, wearing a halter-neck one-piece swimsuit. She appears to be playing with a garden hose or rinsing an object on the grass. The suburban backyard setting features a wheeled chaise lounge chair, a white picket fence in the background, leafy trees, and an ivy-covered tree stump topped with a potted plant. Evocative of idyllic mid-century American suburban childhood during the post-war boom.
